description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for the .NET Stack<T> type, including a serializer (StackCodec<T>) and a copier (StackCopier<T>) for use within Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: StackCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Stack<T> providing write and read functionality for Orleans serialization.

classes.name: StackCopier<T>
classes.description: Provides deep copy capabilities for Stack<T> within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the Stack<T> to a writer, including its length and elements.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Stack<T> from a reader, reconstructing its contents.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Stack<T>.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overloaded)
methods.description: Copies the contents of one Stack<T> to another, deep copying each element.
